name: exposed_strip_extent_binding
mechanism: Bind the original 13-unit long edge to the exposed straight lengths of P and Q in red, inviting the missing-overlap error x+q=13 and x=26/3. The 4-unit fold elbow, 45-degree line, all dashed dimensions and P/Q labels remain intact.
primary_math_proof: Let q be the exposed height of Q. The 45-degree fold consumes a 4 by 4 elbow of strip length 4, so x+4+q=13. Since P=4x and Q=4q with P=2Q, x=2q and 3q=9: q=3,x=6 uniquely. Color is an annotation, not an equality or an extra constraint.

marker_roles.role: Original bottom edge: full length 13 to be wrongly matched to only the two exposed straight spans.
P bottom edge: first constituent x of the misleading exposed-length sum.
Q right side: second constituent q of that sum; it is perpendicular after folding and not a second independent source length.

approval_status: PRIMARY ONLY; requires parent NEW independent review; no Pass/Collect
